features.description: Diagram download + stop wiping the whiteboard on send
acceptance_criteria: "Hent tegning" triggers a .png download; disabled on an empty board
"Tilfoej tegning" stages the image and the ink stays on the board
slugify lifted to lib/download.ts; _exportHelpers.ts re-imports it and still compiles
features.notes: Independent of everything else; ships first.

features.description: WritingElement model, all three activity stores + both adapters, per-group writing_progress store, dual-audience routes
acceptance_criteria: POST an activity with a writing element then GET returns it (round-trip through BOTH adapters)
test_every_element_field_is_present_on_all_activity_models green
writing_progress store: upsert, revision increments, >maxChars rejected, group A cannot read group B
Dual-auth: student reads own group, owner teacher reads all groups, teacher PUT rejected, non-owner 404
features.notes: Recipe step 1b is the failure mode here — the 1.1.48 document regression was a missed adapter, and the model test does not catch it.

features.description: WorkbenchWriting renderer + autosave + all four tutor wirings (push, debounced trust card, manifest describer, fill-state reader)
acceptance_criteria: Typing produces one debounced PUT, one writing.commit push, and exactly ONE trust card per burst
sessionId arrival pushes writing.sync with NO card
Push snapshot tail-truncates at WRITING_PUSH_CHAR_CAP with truncated:true
Feedback button sends the FULL text as a turn and dispatches no card
test_every_registered_element_kind_is_described passes with a real describer, not the generic fallback
test_every_element_kind_declares_a_fill_reader passes; untouched reports EMPTY, typed reports the word count
make audit-trust-cards green
features.notes: Snapshot is calculator-shaped (one array, matched by id), NOT table-shaped — recon finding 1. ElementFill total = min_words or 1 — recon finding 2.

features.description: Export the student's text as txt / md / rtf, client-side, zero new deps
acceptance_criteria: All three formats download with the right extension and MIME type
Danish characters survive the RTF \uNNN? escape (table-driven test)
Every export carries the provenance header (activity, group, date)
Hand-check: the .rtf opens with headings intact in Word, Pages, Google Docs, LibreOffice
features.notes: .docx deliberately deferred — needs a ZIP writer; the HTML-with-.doc-extension trick fabricates a format. JB human gate 1.

features.description: Authoring surfaces — builder editor, co-pilot add_element both sides, CLI parity, palette rename
acceptance_criteria: A teacher adds a writing element in the builder; save then reload and it is still there
add_element(kind="writing") parses, previews, and Applies onto builder state
aiplatform activity can set and read a writing element
The palette no longer offers two things a teacher could read as "notebook" (note relabelled)
features.notes: useActivityBuilder's dep array is hand-maintained — a missed entry silently keeps a stale value (1.1.61 lost tags exactly that way). Test the VALUE after Apply, not the setter call.
